summary: Cognyte Software Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its Q1 FY2027 earnings. Revenue of $105.5M grew 10.4% YoY; GAAP operating income doubled to $4.4M; non-GAAP operating income rose 41.5% to $10.7M; adjusted EBITDA was $13.6M, up 31.5%. The company also disclosed share repurchases of ~$8.2M during the quarter, with $35M of $60M authorization used overall. It has no debt and $109.2M cash. No special situation event—this is a routine earnings update with no M&A, strategic review, or structural change.
